notes: «قال وأخبرني ابن جريج» is Ibn Wahb continuing the same chain (as in the rule 3 example with «قال وحدثني»), not a second branch
«أن الحسن بن مسلم، أخبره» names the source the previous link heard from: a link (rule 5)
«لا يدري الحسن من هي» is a remark inside the saying about the woman who answered; it names no new transmitter
«رضى الله عنهما» is a blessing and is left out
